headline: Pakistan Calls for OIC Economic Solidarity and Enhanced Trade Financing
summary: Pakistan's Commerce Minister Jam Kamal advocated for strengthened trade financing access and supply chain integration among OIC member states at the 42nd COMCEC Ministerial Session in Istanbul.
why: The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) COMCEC framework shapes regional trade tariffs and cross-border commercial ties.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Increased intra-OIC trade coordination aims to bolster member state export access.
